text_block_list.text: One day, as I was walking along the riverbed...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha...! How about that, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Guh, s-so bootiful...!
It's simply divine!!!!"
choice_data_list: What in the world are you...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer-kun!
Of course, just as you can see!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah...
Digitan is gonna pass out...!!
Even after looking, I couldn't make any sense of it, so I asked for more details.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What a splendid morning.
I have awakened, and I walk along the riverbed.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what a picture-perfect scene has been
brought forth into this world...!"
Hyooooooooooot!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...? Was that the wind?
It seemed to echo an awful lot for that, though."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well. First, let's take the photo
for the bromide—"
Muhoo!? A-A photo print!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Right there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wahhhhhh?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And that's what it means, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Digital-kun was watching me
from the nearby woods, after all.
So I went ahead and brought her straight to the best seat in the house!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... To be noticed by my fave,
and have her show me mercy...
This is a memory I'll treasure for the rest of my life...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But back then, how did you even know I was there, Opera O-san...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Vanquish anyone who disturbs the sacred bonds between Umamusume-chans.
Living by that creed, I have mastered the art of blending in as a ceiling, a wall, and even a tree.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, next time I want to be invisible like air...
I don't want to be a stumbling block anymore...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun. You're not a stone,
you are my—fan.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then what are these ears and hands of mine for?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
These ears are meant to hear the voices of the fans,
and these hands are meant to guide your path.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"For the future 'Overlord of the Century's End,'
picking up on the voice of a single fan is child's play."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaaaaaa~~~~?!
How can my fave's face AND heart be this good, aaaah~~~~?!
choice_data_list: So the fans' support really does give you strength, huh.
By the way, what about the bromide photo shoot?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That's exactly it, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Digital-kun. This time,
I'll show you my powerful stride.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Carrying your expectations,
I'll deliver a run that shines even brighter!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll follow youuu!
To the ends of the earth~~!

And T.M. Opera O and the others broke into a run,
accompanied by loud laughter and excited shouts.

...It goes without saying that I hurriedly
rushed them both to the academy's training course
to avoid disturbing the neighborhood...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oops, that's right. As always, your calm composure
as you strive to sort out the situation proves you're
worthy of being my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let me show off my judgment today.
...Digital-kun, I want you to take the photos!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah... For me... Really!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Seeing as you've witnessed my beauty up close, I knew I could trust you with the photography.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Capture me on camera, looking so dazzling
as to charm even the river fairies!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes...! It's time for my camera girl skills to surpass their limits...!

—Agnes Digital's camera skills were indeed magnificent...
and TM Opera O couldn't help but praise her own keen judgment.
